create.name: Jeralyn Glass
create.bio:
Jeralyn Glass is an American singer and sound teacher who came to sound healing after a long performing career. She started out on Broadway, sang opera and concert repertoire on stages in many countries, and for more than twenty years taught voice, both at music institutions and in her own studio. Today she works mainly with crystal alchemy singing bowls, combining them with voice, meditation and ideas drawn from bioenergetics; she is also a certified practitioner of Dr. Sue Morter's Energy Codes.

In Los Angeles she runs the Crystal Cadence studio, which holds several hundred quartz bowls and where she gives sound sessions and helps people choose instruments. Through The Sacred Science of Sound, the teaching side of her work, she offers a short introductory course and multi-day practitioner trainings at Levels 1 to 3, held online and in person in Rancho Palos Verdes, California. She also coaches singers and speakers on finding their natural voice, releases a free guided sound meditation on YouTube each month, and teaches courses on Insight Timer and The Shift Network. Her Hay House titles are Sacred Vibrations, a book on crystalline sound, and the Crystal Sound Healing Oracle, a deck whose cards link to recordings of the bowls.

books.title: Crystal Sound Healing Oracle
books.author: Jeralyn Glass
books.description: A 48-card oracle deck with a guidebook, published by Hay House. Each card carries a QR code that opens a short recording of a crystal singing bowl, so a reading can become a listening practice.

courses.title: Crystal Alchemy Singing Bowl Trainings (The Sacred Science of Sound)
courses.description: Her practitioner path in crystal bowl sound work: a four-hour online introduction, then four-day Level 1 and Level 2 trainings and a Level 3 immersion. Courses run live online or in person in Rancho Palos Verdes, California, and cover the bowls, music theory, voice and leading group and one-to-one sound sessions.
courses.price: Introductory course $444 USD; Level 1 from $2,800 USD (virtual)

courses.title: Sound Healing Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sound baths with crystal bowls, tuning forks and her voice, held online with a stereo recording to keep, or in person at your home. She also leads themed sound events for groups and companies.

courses.title: Private Mentoring: Crystal Alchemy Singing Bowls & Finding Your Authentic Voice
courses.description: Private coaching from a long-serving voice teacher, for singers, speakers and sound practitioners. Sessions work on breath support, range and grounded, natural expression, and can bring the singing bowls into practice.

courses.title: Heart Activation Sound Healing Bath Recording - Digital Download
courses.description: A recorded group sound bath built around the heart, played on crystal alchemy bowls, sold as a video download. It was made as a shared practice of connection for listeners joining from many places.

free_resources.title: Tune Up Tuesday: free monthly crystal bowl meditations
free_resources.description: A YouTube playlist of her free guided sound meditations. A new one of roughly fifteen minutes comes out each month, usually built on a seasonal theme or a single intention.
